subject: Redwood onboarding: Console walkthrough + API enablement
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@nextwavepay.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding: Console walkthrough + API enablement

Hi Rafael —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We’re ready to kick off the onboarding sessions for NextWave Pay. Our goal is two focused blocks: a console walkthrough for product and support (getting comfortable with dashboards, RBAC, runtime monitoring) and a hands-on API enablement for our engineering team (keys, client SDKs, rate limits, test payloads).

Proposed slots from our side (PT):
- Tue Mar 19, 10:00–12:00 — Console walkthrough (we expect ~6 people: product, support lead, SRE)
- Thu Mar 21, 13:00–14:00 — API enablement (2 engineers + engineering manager)

Quick questions:
- If you recommend combining those into a single half-day, we can consider it but prefer split days to make sure key stakeholders can attend.
- Can you share a short runbook and any pre-reqs we should complete?
- Do you need our API keys or sample data ahead of time?

Attendees: Samira Khan (Head of Integrations), Alex Duarte (Senior Platform Eng), Priya Shah (Support Manager) — I included Alex on cc.

Thanks — looking forward to confirming times.

Best,
Samira
Head of Integrations, NextWave Pay
[samirak@nextwavepay.com]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@nextwavepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Mar 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: Console walkthrough + API enablement

Samira —

Appreciate the clear ask. Split days work fine; a couple of notes / suggestions from our side:

1) If it helps reduce context-switching we can run a combined half-day (Wednesday) that covers the console deep-dive then drops into API hands-on. If senior execs need to keep the two-day plan, we’ll support that.

2) Pre-reqs & runbook: attaching a concise runbook (see "Redwood-Onboard-Runbook-v1.pdf" attached) — it lists sandbox access steps, test token generation, and a small checklist for each attendee. Please have at least one engineer with terminal access to run the sample curl commands during the API session.

3) Calendar: I can send calendar invites for the two proposed slots or for the combined session — which do you prefer?

4) Prep call: if Alex wants a 30-min pre-call to walk through proxy/network questions, Ben can take that (he’s cc’ed).

If you’re OK with split days, I’ll draft invites for Tue Mar 19 10:00–12:00 and Thu Mar 21 13:00–14:00 PT and include the runbook + test credentials instructions in the invite body.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

Attachments:
- Redwood-Onboard-Runbook-v1.pdf (pdf, 420KB)

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@nextwavepay.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@nextwavepay.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2029 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: Console walkthrough + API enablement

Thanks Rafael —

After checking calendars, the combined half-day would conflict with our execs. We prefer to keep the split approach but need a small timing change for the API session: Alex has a partner call on Thu 21 and asked if we can move the API enablement to Fri Mar 22 at 08:00 PT (he’s on EU hours and that earlier US time works for him). The console walkthrough can stay Tue Mar 19 10:00–12:00 PT.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm you can record the API session and upload a short clip + the runbook? Our onboarding manager may need to share the recording with the broader team.
- We also have a security/compliance questionnaire in flight (SOC2 evidence). Someone on your team may get pinged by our security team; just a heads up.

If Marissa or Ben need anything from our side to prep keys/test data, let us know.

Appreciate it,
Samira

--
On Mon, Mar 11, 2029 at 07:03 Samira Khan <samira.k@nextwavepay.com> wrote:
> Adding Alex for visibility — he’ll drive API session details.
>
Samira

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@nextwavepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2029 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: Console walkthrough + API enablement

Samira —

All set. Thanks for the update — we’ll keep the sessions split and move the API enablement to Fri Mar 22 08:00–09:00 PT as requested. Final schedule below (PT):

- Tue Mar 19, 10:00–12:00 — Console walkthrough (recording ON; product + support + SRE)
- Fri Mar 22, 08:00–09:00 — API enablement (hands-on; recording ON)

Action items assigned:
- Redwood: Ben will run the console walkthrough and cover dashboards + RBAC. Marissa will lead the API hands-on and coordinate test tokens. I’ve attached calendar invites (Console-Walkthrough.ics, API-Enablement.ics) and the runbook link.
- NextWave: Please confirm final attendee list and have at least one engineer on the API call with terminal access.
- Security/compliance: forwarding to Redwood Security (security@redwood.com) — someone will respond to the SOC2 request within 24–48h.

Links & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cOnboardRunbook (runbook) | https://hubspot.com/deal/records/NW-3891

I’ve also included a short checklist below to paste into the invite body for attendees:
- Confirm sandbox access and that test token works (curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate)
- One terminal per engineer for the API session
- Bring network / proxy questions to the 30-min pre-call if needed (Ben will schedule on request)

If anything changes, we’ll adjust. Looking forward to getting NextWave on the platform.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

Attachments referenced:
- Console-Walkthrough.ics (calendar invite)
- API-Enablement.ics (calendar invite)
- Redwood-Onboard-Runbook-v1.pdf (runbook link provided)
